sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and fixed-address rule
sections.what: Brings in navigation, the not-found helper, the sport list, the room lookup, a status badge, and the rooms stylesheet. It sets the route to accept only known sports.
sections.why: Likely reason: stops unknown sport addresses from reaching the page.

sections.name: generateStaticParams, SPORT
sections.title: Sports to build ahead
sections.what: Builds one page for each sport in the shared list, and holds a short display name table for the five sports.
sections.why: Likely reason: the same as the room pages, to build pages in advance and reject unknown sports.
sections.watch_out: The display names here are a second copy of the list on the rooms home page, so both must change together.

sections.name: generateMetadata
sections.title: Tab title for each sport
sections.what: Sets the tab title to the sport name followed by Rooms, or to Sport if the name is unknown.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the tab title readable even for an unexpected sport.

sections.name: SportRoomsPage
sections.title: Sport page with its rooms
sections.what: Checks the sport is valid and loads its rooms. If the sport has a pending note, it shows the source-pending badge and the note. Otherwise it lists each room as a tile linking to its page.
sections.why: The pending state explains the gap, in line with the rooms home page wording about licensed sources.
sections.watch_out: A sport with no rooms and no pending note shows an empty list with no explanation.

summary: Page for one sport, listing its recorded event rooms or showing a source-pending note.
purpose: Lets visitors pick a match room for one sport.
why: Rooms are grouped by sport, and sports without a licensed source are explained rather than shown empty.
how: Steps in order: the route accepts only the known sports. It loads that sport's rooms. If the sport has a pending note, it shows the note with a source-pending badge. Otherwise it lists each room as a tile that links to its page.
inputs: The sport part of the web address and the room data.
outputs: A sport page with a list of rooms, or a pending note.
risks: The display name table repeats the sport list from another file. A sport with no rooms and no pending note shows an empty list with no explanation.
debug: If a sport shows pending unexpectedly, check the room service's data for that sport. If the title is wrong, check the display name table.
